benchmark.explanation: cli.py adds receipt/wiki commands; evaluate.py adds target FP/FN, signed error, disagreement, grouping guards and policy pairs. Original score expressions retain their definitions (false-target count is factored into a local variable); all old saved fields must reproduce. Additional top-level modules also change the package aggregate.
